label: TP
reason: User-provided parameter reaches the sink via doSomething(), which assigns param to bar when the guard condition is met. The guard expression (500/42) + num > 200 evaluates to 196+196=392 > 200, which is always true, so user input directly flows into bar and is then concatenated into the HTML output via encodeForHTML(), creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: param assigned to bar and embedded in HTML output
